newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Itau still attractive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Itau still attractive.

text.p: -- Bear, Stearns said it was reiterating its attractive rating for Brazilian private bank Banco Itau.

-- The brokerage said Banco Itau reported a $419 million net profit in the first nine months and a $12.40 net per 1,000 shares for the third quarter, above its quarterly estimates of $10.28 and market consensus of $10.22.
-- It also said the bank's nine-month earnings per 1,000 shares reached $34.80, "which leaves our full year target of $45.10 fully achievable."
-- On Friday, Banco Itau preferred shares closed at 431 reais.
